create_VisionLanguage2DSemanticMapState: create a VisionLanguage2DSemanticMapState instance with device, num_environments, lseg_features_dim, map_resolution, map_size_cm, and global_downscaling parameters
init_map_and_pose: initialize global and local map and sensor pose variables for all environments in the VisionLanguage2DSemanticMapState
get_semantic_map: get a local map of semantic categories by decoding CLIP features to a label set using an LSegEncDecNet model
get_planner_pose_inputs: get local planner pose inputs combining global pose and local map boundaries for a specific environment
update_global_goal_for_env: update the global goal map for a specific environment with a binary goal map chosen by the policy
